digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup/config/auth architecture
propositions: MCP and review-bot services must capture static deployment/startup config once at process startup, not re-read per-operation or per-tool-call, to prevent inconsistent state changes under long-running processes.

Each operation/request must receive a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot composed at runtime, while inbound bearer tokens remain request-scoped and never enter startup snapshots, serialization, or logs.

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (gerrit_bot_token, GitHub, LLM credentials) before accepting work and must not fall back to alternative principals if auth is missing, conflicting, or revoked.
Static binding changes (rotated env/file material) must be observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capabilities remain unchanged.
Partial or rejected telemetry configuration (Langfuse/OTLP) must disable observability without changing operation results, while security/auth remains fail-closed.
MCP inbound OAuth and bearer tokens must remain transient request context absent from startup bindings, operation snapshots, caches, schemas, and child processes.
